description: Smart Control for Heavy Appliances: Power your ACs, geysers, heaters, and air coolers with this 16A Wi-Fi smart plug—ideal for heavy appliances. Experience hassle-free automation and intelligent energy consumption with a tap or voice command. No Hub, No Hassle: Avoid the hub and join wirelessly—this smart plug plugs into 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network directly. Easy installation and instant access to smarter control of your home appliances without additional devices. Real-time Energy Monitoring: Keep tabs on your appliances' current energy consumption using the DigiTap app. Conserve energy, conserve money, and be aware of high-consumption appliances such as geysers and air conditioners. Schedule Your Power: Create daily or weekly schedules for appliances to turn on or off automatically. Start your day with a warm bath or come home to a cooled room—automate comfort without drawing extra power, even when you are not there. Voice-controlled Convenience: Voice-operate your devices with Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant. Simply command to switch on your AC, kettle, or table fan—never so convenient and voice-controlled was smart life. Access from Anywhere: Home, office, or abroad, control your devices from anywhere with the Havells DigiTap app. Keep your home's power consumption under your control—at anytime, anywhere. Ideal Partner for Smart Homes: From water pumps to electric kettles, this plug handles them all at once. An essential for every new-age home seeking a smarter, safer, and energy-efficient way of life. Small Size, Big Features: White, narrow, and unobtrusive, it blends into your environment without sacrificing its high-powered features. Designed to take up little space but deliver maximum convenience and smart control. Plug with Top Smart Plugs: Built to compete with the best—The Havells smart plug delivers premium performance, advanced security, and unsurpassed convenience in a single effective solution. Your Gateway to Smarter Living: 16A capacity, energy monitoring, app, voice command, and hassle-free setup. This plug is revolutionizing convenience. Bring smart automation to your life and turn your regular device into a smart powerhouse.
